headline: Claude Code expands capabilities for scientific workflows and enterprise automation
body: Anthropic is extending increased Claude Code usage limits through August 31 while the model demonstrates accelerating capabilities in protein design, analytical chemistry, and enterprise automation tasks like macOS driver development. For healthcare AI applications, this matters because Claude Code's expanding capacity directly impacts the velocity of clinical tool development, EHR integration automation, and biomedical research workflows that rely on code generation. The automatic session continuation feature and sustained usage increases signal Anthropic's commitment to supporting long-running healthcare IT projects that typically require iterative development cycles. Healthcare consulting firms and vendors evaluating Claude for clinical documentation assistance, lab workflow automation, or research acceleration should track these capability expansions as indicators of production readiness for regulated environments.
